lxc_rootfs_dir.description: Base directory where container root filesystems and metadata are stored.

default_template.description: Path to the default template used when creating new containers.

bridge_name.description: Name of the default bridge interface to connect container veth pairs to.

container_mac.description: Last three bytes for generating a default MAC address for containers (first 3 bytes are fixed).

networks.description: List of network interfaces to configure for containers (in addition to default bridge).

type.description: Interface type: veth (default), macvlan, ipvlan, physical, empty, etc.

link.description: Host interface or bridge to connect this interface to (e.g., eth0, lxcbr0).

name.description: Name of the interface inside the container.

hwaddr.description: MAC address for the container interface (auto-generated if omitted).

veth_pair.description: Name of the veth pair interface on the host (auto-generated if omitted).

gateway.description: IPv4 gateway to configure inside the container for this interface.

ipv4_addresses.description: List of IPv4 addresses (CIDR notation) assigned to this interface inside the container.

ipv6_addresses.description: List of IPv6 addresses (CIDR notation) assigned to this interface inside the container.

use_cgroup_v2.description: Enable unified cgroup v2 hierarchy (required on modern systemd-based hosts).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: OFF, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE (in increasing verbosity).

log_file.description: Path to the global LXC log file.
